text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aww, bummer. Crane games really are tough, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you don't need to apologize! Just 
knowing you tried so hard to win it for my 
siblings makes me happy♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Come on, chin up, Trainer! Let's just 
think of it as an offering to the crane 
game today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Luck comes and goes... Today, I gifted 
good luck to the world in the form of an 
offering. That way, it'll come right back 
around to me eventually, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
